key_impacts: Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak.
Two refineries in New Jersey were shut down, resulting in the loss of 26.3% of 1,170,200 barrels-per-day operating capacity.
Gas stations in New Jersey could not operate due to power outages.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to the outage.
Storm surge flooding exceeded the 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide in New York City.
missing_information: Event duration beyond 2012-10-29 not fully specified.
Specific names of damaged MTA river crossings and evacuated hospitals not provided in the text excerpt.
